data.title: About Kelly
bio: As a trusted advisor for my clients, I understand that buying and selling a home is deeply personal and complex process.  There is also a lot at stake personally and financially.  I recognize and value the trust my clients place in me and strive to exceed their expectations.

I understand the market and all the variables in a real estate transaction, and I want to make sure you feel supported knowing you have a trusted advisor with a great team behind her .  As a NJ native I've lived, worked, and went to school here.  I know all the Ins and outs of Monmouth and ocean county, and I'm very knowledgeable in the surrounding areas.
With this knowledge and experience I know I can be an asset to you as a buyer or seller.
